page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top with the printed page number at the right. Above the text, one italic line running on from the previous page. Author name "Rainoldus." centred in italics. Main text below. One marginal note in the right margin at the Isaiah reference.

p.i: cant, de quibus tam eximia laudes praedicatur, eos nihilominus idololatras ff, defunctorum manes, & cadavera, picturasque & statuas adorare,

main_text.p: 3 Papistas in Sanctorum invocatione, reliquiarum cultu, imaginum veneratione, manifestam impietatem & idololatriam exercere queruntur nostri. Hoc autem esse falsum, & iniustam ipsis infamiam irrogare, Bellarminus dicit: sed nihil affert hactenus, quo dictum suum adstruat; & post, quum affert, nihil affert. Interim, quod nequit probare argumentis, id ut perturbandis affectibus suffuretur: non solum nos in odium rapere conatur, verum etiam amorem & miserationem sui commovere.

4 Atque, ut odium erga nos accendat: criminationes infert, nec paucas numero, & atrocitate graves. Primam, quod multa in Romana Ecclesia, templis, monasteriis, gymnasiis, dogmatibus, ritibus, hominibus denique omnium ordinum reprehendamus, multa desideremus, multa carpa-mus, multa emendanda & corrigenda esse clami-temus. ubi, more hominum, nobis vitio vertit, quod debebat sibi. Neque enim medicus accusandus est, qui multos pravos humores, medicamenti-que purgantibus egentes, in aegri corpore depre-hendit, sed aeger, cuius culpa & intemperantia hu-mores exundarunt. Nisi forte Esaias meretur castigationem, qui de Iudaeis agens, a Efai.1.6.{a}planta, inquit, pedis usque ad caput, non est in isto corpore integritas: sed vulnus, & tumex, ac plaga saniosa.

page.notes: Marginal note "a Efai.1.6." in the right margin is partly faint; "Efai" and the colon/dot after 1.6 are doubtful. The reference mark before "planta" is a superscript 2 with a caret over the A; I read it as mark {a}. "tumex" is doubtful and may be a printing error for "tumor". The top italic line is a fragment; its "ff" after "idololatras" is doubtful. Underlining in "ubi, more hominum, nobis vitio vertit, quod" is not reproduced. The first word "Quod" has a large initial Q, transcribed plainly. No catchword or signature visible.
